解 利用含参变量积分一致收敛性的性质, 以下计算过程是正确的:

pages.content: \begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {\alpha - 1} \ln x}{1 - x} \mathrm{d} x = \lim _ {\beta \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {\alpha - 1} \ln x}{(1 - x) ^ {\beta}} \mathrm{d} x = \lim _ {\beta \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \frac {\partial}{\partial \alpha} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {\alpha - 1}}{(1 - x) ^ {\beta}} \mathrm{d} x \\ = \lim _ {\beta \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \frac {\partial}{\partial \alpha} \mathrm{B} (\alpha , 1 - \beta) = \lim _ {\beta \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \frac {\partial}{\partial \alpha} \frac {\Gamma (\alpha) \Gamma (1 - \beta)}{\Gamma (1 + \alpha - \beta)} \\ = \lim _ {\beta \to 1 ^ {-}} \left(\frac {\Gamma^ {\prime} (\alpha) \Gamma (1 - \beta)}{\Gamma (1 + \alpha - \beta)} - \frac {\Gamma (\alpha) \Gamma (1 - \beta) \Gamma^ {\prime} (1 + \alpha - \beta)}{\Gamma^ {2} (1 + \alpha - \beta)}\right) \\ = \lim _ {\beta \to 1 ^ {-}} \frac {\Gamma^ {\prime} (\alpha) \Gamma (1 + \alpha - \beta) - \Gamma (\alpha) \Gamma^ {\prime} (1 + \alpha - \beta)}{1 - \beta} \frac {\Gamma (2 - \beta)}{\Gamma^ {2} (1 + \alpha - \beta)} \\ = \lim _ {\beta \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \left(\Gamma^ {\prime} (\alpha) \Gamma^ {\prime} (1 + \alpha - \beta) - \Gamma (\alpha) \Gamma^ {\prime \prime} (1 + \alpha - \beta)\right) \frac {\Gamma (1)}{\Gamma^ {2} (\alpha)} \\ = \frac {(\Gamma^ {\prime} (\alpha)) ^ {2} - \Gamma (\alpha) \Gamma^ {\prime \prime} (\alpha)}{\Gamma^ {2} (\alpha)}. \\ \end{array}

\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {\alpha - 1} \ln x}{1 - x} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \alpha} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {\alpha - 1} - 1}{1 - x} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \alpha} \lim _ {\beta \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {\alpha - 1} - 1}{(1 - x) ^ {\beta}} \mathrm{d} x \\ = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \alpha} \lim _ {\beta \to 1 ^ {-}} (\mathrm{B} (\alpha , 1 - \beta) - \mathrm{B} (1, 1 - \beta)) \\ = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \alpha} \lim _ {\beta \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \left(\frac {\Gamma (\alpha) \Gamma (1 - \beta)}{\Gamma (\alpha + 1 - \beta)} - \frac {\Gamma (1) \Gamma (1 - \beta)}{\Gamma (2 - \beta)}\right) \\ = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \alpha} \lim _ {\beta \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \frac {\Gamma (\alpha) \Gamma (2 - \beta) - \Gamma (\alpha + 1 - \beta)}{1 - \beta} \frac {\Gamma (2 - \beta)}{\Gamma (\alpha + 1 - \beta)} \\ = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \alpha} \lim _ {\beta \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \left(\Gamma (\alpha) \Gamma^ {\prime} (2 - \beta) - \Gamma^ {\prime} (\alpha + 1 - \beta)\right) \frac {1}{\Gamma (\alpha)} \\ = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \alpha} \left(\Gamma^ {\prime} (1) - \frac {\Gamma^ {\prime} (\alpha)}{\Gamma (\alpha)}\right) \\ = - (\ln \Gamma (\alpha)) ^ {\prime \prime}. \\ \end{array}

pages.content: \begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\ln x}{1 - x} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\ln (1 - x)}{x} \mathrm{d} x = - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {x ^ {n - 1}}{n} \mathrm{d} x \\ = - \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {n - 1}}{n} \mathrm{d} x = - \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} = - \frac {\pi^ {2}}{6}. \\ \end{array}
